entries.kind: AI edited product render, holiday let setting
entries.description: A grey hard sided cool box on a warm oak floor in front of floor to ceiling sliding glass doors, rolling green fields and hills outside. Two black straps printed "BREAKOUT BOX" in white cross over the lid with a combination lock where they cross. On the lid sit lilac papers (one with large letters partly hidden by the strap, "THE ...IST"), six pencils and a QR card. The box has a pull handle on the left end and a wheel at the right rear. The filename is an Adobe Firefly prompt ("move the box closer to the window, so no furniture is visible in the shot"). Zoomed at full size the tells are clear: the lock face, the embossed lid lettering and the card text are garbled, the QR is mush, surfaces have the painterly over sharpened Firefly texture. Shape matches the real box in the LinkedIn photos (two round cup holders on the lid, side latches, a raised strip along the lid edge where the real one has its ruler), so it is most likely a real box photo regenerated in Firefly. No real photo we found shows the sides, so the wheels and pull handle are unverified.
entries.useForBuild: The only image of the box in a holiday let setting, and 2048px. Owen published it himself, so it can appear as his. Do not crop in on the lid, the AI garble shows. Never caption it as a real customer property.

entries.kind: AI generated or AI edited scene, game in play
entries.description: Top down desk scene on dark wood. A puzzle 1 "Entry Point" style sheet with a blue skyscraper blueprint and red value boxes labelled ROOF, MAIN ENTRANCE, SCAFFOLDING, BASEMENT. Its left text column is AI gibberish ("STIRING THE'T'E Botry 96/100", "GITARDS"). Top right a black folder with a BREAKOUT BOX mark. Top left a small digital timer. Bottom right a hand writing "Puzzle 1 - 8 = ?" in pencil on a notepad printed with a BREAKOUT BOX mark whose lock digits read "888", where the real logo reads "149". Filename is an Adobe Firefly prompt ("remove the compass"). The roof values in the image do not match the /hints walkthrough (10 x 1 x 10).
entries.useForBuild: Do not use. Garbled text and the wrong logo digits, and anyone who has played will see the sheet is not the real one.

entries.description: White glowing line drawing of the cool box in three quarter view, with wheels, a pull handle, two cup holders, two latches and two straps reading "BREAKOUT BOX".
